clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1. Scope—Requirements for taper washers for use with Indian Standard Medium Weight Channels (ISMC) with bolts in diameter range of 10 to 39 mm.

clauses.title: Designation – Shall be
clauses.text: 4. Designation - Shall be designated by the name, size and number of the standard. For example, a taper washer of nominal size 18 mm shall be designated as `Taper Washer 18 - IS : 5372'. * General requirements for plain washers and lock    washers (first revision). SUMMARY OF IS 5372 : 1975 TAPER WASHERS FOR CHANNELS (ISMC) (First Revision)
